A Strategy-owned Study-only browser journey covers normal-user validate/run, automatic Results arrival, accurate artifacts, and draft-versus-saved identity; the complete unchanged full local profile and exact-source CI remain required before readiness.

Preserve all original 18 roadmap criteria and accepted checkpoint history; retain honest limits and disabled native/forward/broker/capital/provider-live scopes. Full platform profile and any Root-owned genuine target acceptance remain distinct and open.

Dashboard search keeps prefix results as identity-bearing candidates; it resolves only a unique exact match from complete discovery or an explicit candidate choice, and failed symbol/comparison saves retain the prior configuration with visible retry feedback.
Dashboard layout-save failures restore the saved arrangement, explain the failure, and allow a retry that reconciles the visible layout with the server.
